identity_check: Confirmed as Arda Industries, Inc. (arda.ai; site title 'Arda Industries – AI for Manufacturing'). The privacy policy names Arda Industries, Inc. and gives 'Location: San Francisco, CA, USA'. arda.ai image labels name the co-founders: Bob McGrew (CEO, former OpenAI Chief Research Officer), Augustus Odena (Chief AI Officer, Adept co-founder), Alex Mark (CTO) and Jakob Frick (co-founder). The Next Web (2026-10-20) names the same four and quotes McGrew: 'We started Arda in 2025'. The 'Matt Grimm, co-Founder & COO' shown on arda.ai is Anduril's co-founder and COO, quoted as a customer (The Next Web), not an Arda founder. Matched on domain, founders and the design-to-production description, not on name alone. Category direct and layer process_planning kept from our notes: the homepage says Arda cuts 'the manual work involved in process planning, instructions, and design changes' and supports schedulers, supply-chain teams and technicians on the factory floor, which overlaps Utopian Autonomy's BOM / engineering-drawing and plant-floor agents. Contradiction with our notes: Augustus Odena is one of four co-founders (with Alex Mark and Jakob Frick), not McGrew's only co-founder.

pages.title: Ex-OpenAI research chief Bob McGrew’s Arda raises $232M for US factories
Ex-OpenAI Research Chief Bob McGrew's Arda Raises $230M at $1.5B
Arda raises $230 million at $1.5 billion valuation to automate US manufacturing

company.name: Arda
company.description: AI software that turns product designs into factory process plans, work instructions and station layouts, and updates them when designs change.

layer_detail: Design-to-production process planning: builds the bill of process (operations, tools, quality checks, fixtures, stations, visual work instructions) from CAD, PDFs and PLM data; propagates design revisions to the floor; feeds production data back for schedulers, supply-chain teams and technicians. Starting with manual assembly lines in defence and data-centre electrical equipment; prototyping agents that program robots.
product_summary: Agent-driven manufacturing-engineering software. It ingests CAD, PDFs, PLM data and requirements, builds a shared product model, then generates assembly order, operations, fixtures, station layouts and visual work instructions for engineers to review. It pushes design revisions to the floor and feeds production data back; robot-programming agents are in prototype.
